origin.says: 𤣩 (jade, gem) for the meaning plus 𡿺 (the right part of 脑 brain) as the sound: used in 玛瑙 (agate), a banded gem.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 吉 (lucky) as the sound: a plant name, now used for the tangerine.

ety.hint: To scratch 扌 a flea bite 蚤; 蚤 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 蚤 (flea) as the sound: to scratch, what one does after a flea bite.

煸.def: to stir-fry before broiling or stewing

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 索 (rope) as the sound: to suck; also used in words for shivering and wordiness.
Originally 宀 (house) over 頁 (head): only one person in the house, alone. Added strokes made the bottom look like 分 (divide), and the head is now unrecognisable.
芻 (fodder) as the sound plus 隹 (bird) for the meaning: a young bird, a chick. Simplified from 雛 by writing 芻 (fodder) as 刍.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 全 (whole) as the sound: a wooden peg, a stopper, a bolt.
月 (here flesh) for the meaning plus 泉 (spring) as the sound and a hint: a part of the body that wells up fluids, a gland. A modern coinage for the medical term.
Simplified from 盧, first a drawing of an oven or rice pot, with 虍 (tiger) as sound and 皿 (dish) added. The simple form is a cursive outline, now ⺊ (divine) over 尸 (body).

跤.def: to tumble, to fall; to wrestle

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 交 (to cross) as the sound, legs tangling: to trip and fall; to wrestle.

跤.name: tumble

骇.def: to terrify, to shock, to frighten

origin.says: Simplified from 駭: 馬 (horse) became 马. 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 亥 (twelfth earthly branch) as the sound: a horse startled and bolting, hence 'to shock, to frighten'.

骇.name: spooked horse

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus a shortened 吹 (to blow) as sound and meaning: blowing on the fire to cook.

烙.def: to burn, to brand; hot iron

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound: to burn a mark in, to brand, to iron.

烙.name: branding iron

ety.hint: Three tally marks; compare ten 十 and twenty 廿

唆.def: to make mischief; to instigate, to incite

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 夋 (a walking figure) as the sound: to egg someone on with words, to incite.

唆.name: incite

掖.def: to tuck, to fold; to support

渍.def: to soak, to steep; dye, stains; sodden

origin.says: 酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 甘 (sweet) as the sound, which also fits: drinking to one's content, merry with wine, to one's heart's content.

褚.def: bag, valise; to pad, to stuff; surname

origin.says: A claw-like hand (now written 叉, fork) above 虫 (insect): the insect that makes you scratch, the flea. One source takes the top as the sound instead.
石 (stone) for the meaning plus 见 (see) as the sound: the stone on which ink is ground. Simplified from 硯 (見 → 见).
台 (platform) as the sound above 心 (heart) for the meaning: a slack heart, idle and negligent.
马 (horse) for the meaning plus 川 (river) as the sound: a tamed, docile horse, to tame. Simplified from 馴 (馬 → 马).

哆.def: to quiver, to tremble, to shudder

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 多 (many) as the sound: first an open mouth, now used in 哆嗦 (to shiver, tremble).

哆.name: quiver

迸.def: to gush, to burst; to crack, to split

origin.says: 丹 (cinnabar red) plus 彡 (brush strokes): painted with red, vermilion. Some sources take 彡 as the sound instead.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 耶 (a question particle) as the sound: the coconut palm.

赃.def: booty, loot; stolen goods; to bribe

origin.says: Traditional 贓: 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 臧 (good) as the sound: stolen goods, loot. Simplified as 贝 with 庄 (village) as the new sound part.

赃.name: loot

吆.def: to cry, to bawl; to yell, to shout

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 幺 (tiny) as the sound: to shout, to cry out.

吆.name: shout out

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 凡 (ordinary) as the sound: a mineral, 'alum'. The traditional 礬 had 樊 (fence) as the sound; the simplified form swapped it for 凡.

辙.def: track, rut; stuck in a rut

ety.hint: Something left 育 by a cart 车 when it moves 攵

origin.says: Simplified from 轍: 車 (wagon) for the meaning plus a shortened 徹 (to go through) as the sound: the ruts a wagon wears. 徹 lost its 彳 (step) and kept the right part.

辙.name: wheel rut

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 斤 (axe) as the sound: the celery plant.

ety.hint: A wide 广 plain under the sun 日; 广 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 曠: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 廣 (wide) as the sound: wide open land under the sun. The simplified form keeps only 广, dropping 黃.

ety.hint: A fortress 宀 with walls made of wood 木

origin.says: 𡨄 (to block up) for sound and meaning plus 木 (wood): a palisade of logs that blocks the way, a stockade.

瓢.def: a ladle made from a dried gourd

origin.says: 票 (ticket) as the sound plus 瓜 (gourd) for the meaning: a ladle made from a dried, halved gourd.

瓢.name: gourd ladle

origin.says: Simplified from 囉: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 羅 (bird net) as the sound: chattering on, long-winded. It uses the simplified 罗.

狄.def: barbarians; a tribe from northern China; surname

origin.says: 分 (divide) as the sound over 心 (heart) for the meaning: a heart stirred up, anger, indignation.

卵.def: egg, ovum, roe; ovary, testes; to spawn

origin.says: A picture of eggs or spawn: two sacs with an egg dot in each.

卵.name: ovum

孵.def: to brood over eggs, to incubate, to hatch

ety.hint: To brood 孚 over eggs 卵

origin.says: 卵 (egg) for the meaning plus 孚 (to brood) as the sound, which also helps the meaning: to sit on eggs and hatch them.

孵.name: hatch

霁.def: to subside; to clear up after a storm; to stop being angry

赊.def: to buy and sell on credit

ety.hint: Another 它 person 亻; see 他 and 她 for modern variants

origin.says: A picture of a food container with handles on a foot: a dish or vessel.

皿.name: dish
皿.in: 监益温盟盖盛蓝盗盘篮猛滥盈尴盒盐槛盆隘瘟磕蕴盏孟溢盔锰

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 伐 (chop down) as the sound: a raft of bamboo poles.

睨.def: to glare at, to look askance, to squint

沧.def: azure, cold, vast (all as of the sea)

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 仓 (granary) as the sound: the blue-green cold of the open sea. Simplified from 滄, with 倉 (granary) shortened to 仓.

沧.name: sea blue

ety.hint: The sun 日, covered 冖, with 六 providing the pronunciation

origin.says: First 冖 (cover) over 日 (sun) with 廾 (two hands) below: the sun covered, dark. The two hands later turned into 六 (six), which means nothing here.
衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 辱 (insult) as the sound: a padded mattress, bedding.

ety.hint: Birds 乡 living together in a village 乡

讥.def: to ridicule, to mock, to jeer

origin.says: Simplified from 譏: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 幾 (a few) as the sound: to mock. 言 became 讠 and the sound part 幾 was replaced by its simple stand-in 几 (small table).

讥.name: ridicule

珥.def: pearl or jade earring; to insert, to stick

ety.hint: An ear 耳 ring 王; 耳 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 戎 (arms) as the sound: fine soft fibre, velvet, wool. Simplified from 絨.

苟.def: careless, frivolous, illicit; but, if only

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 句 (hooked) as the sound: first a kind of grass; borrowed for "careless" and "if only".

苟.name: careless

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 舀 (scoop) as the sound: water surging and overflowing.

弋.def: to catch, to arrest; to shoot with a bow

ety.hint: Picture of an arrow shot from a bow

弋.in: 代式试武贷袋赋鹉腻贰拭斌

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 利 (sharp) as the sound, and its sense too: a sharp, quick person, 'clever, nimble'.
A later variant of 殺 (kill), listed as the same word in old rhyme dictionaries: the top has worn into 刍 (fodder) and 攵 (striking hand), with 灬 (fire) at the bottom. Hence a killing, baleful spirit.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 皇 (emperor) as the sound: a fearful heart, anxious.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 令 (command) as the sound: first a performer, a musician; now also in words for clever and lonely.
氵 (water) added to 益 (overflowing vessel), which also gives the sound, once 益 had come to mean 'benefit': to overflow.
A hand (once 又 (hand)) holding up a pole or flag, the same old drawing as 史 (scribe) and 事 (affair): someone acting for the ruler, an official. The hand and pole have merged into one shape.
Simplified from 謄: 言 (speech, writing) for the meaning plus 朕 (I, the emperor) as the sound. The simplification dropped the 月 (moon) of 朕, leaving its top over 言: to copy out a text.

ety.hint: Two arrows 丨 pulled across a bow

origin.says: Early forms show a cord wound around two sticks: an arrow tied to stakes with a line for hunting, or sticks bound to keep them straight. The sign was borrowed for its sound to mean 'not'.

檐.def: the eaves of a house; edge, brim

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 詹 (a sound part) for the sound: the wooden eaves jutting out over a house. Replaces the older form with 竹 (bamboo) on top.

檐.name: eaves

呜.def: the sound of someone crying or sobbing

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 乌 (crow) as the sound: the sound of sobbing or a mournful cry. Simplified from 嗚 by writing 烏 as 乌.

呜.name: whimper

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 亢 (high) as the sound: the throat; also to make a sound.
